chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
"Whoeverone who does not pray with the Imam in congregation on the day of Eid, for him there is no prayer and no making up (qada) for it."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Eid prayer if missed in congregation with the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith from the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the communal obligation (or strong emphasis on congregation) of the Eid prayer by linking its validity directly to praying with the Imam. It highlights the jurisprudential view that missing the congregational aspect renders the prayer incomplete, with no subsequent *qada* (make-up) required, thereby emphasizing the social and spiritual significance of the Eid gathering in Shia tradition.
